title: The Last Dance
vision: At exactly 00:00 the ceiling comes down.
Dust and mold. You can’t breathe.
An iron beam, and Emily beneath it.
wake: You open your eyes. 14:00. Your hands are shaking, and the wedding program is still in them.

flowers.text: “Wild meadow mix, just like she asked.” The bride is crying with joy. Sam sneezes, laughs, sneezes again.

left.label: Send them back
left.after: The bride stops smiling. Sam stops sneezing.

right.label: Keep them, cool the hall
right.after: The bride hugs you. Sam wipes his eyes and says he’s fine.

pill.text: Two hundred guests. Your hands are already shaking. The pill works, but it turns your fingers to wood.

left.label: Take the pill
left.after: It kicks in. Your hands stop. You can’t quite feel them.

right.label: Just breathe
right.after: In, out. Your head clears. Your hands don’t.

chandelier.text: The crystal chandelier is swaying, and there’s no wind. The caterer looks up and says nothing.

left.label: Add a support rope
left.after: Thick rope, tied to the old beam. It looks safe. It looks very safe.

right.label: Hide it with tulle
right.after: Light fabric, nothing more. You try to stop looking up.

tie.text: “Mate, I can’t breathe in this thing.” The photographer is already shouting for the groom.

left.label: Loosen it
left.after: He takes a huge breath. The photographer rolls his eyes.

right.label: “Hold on, photos”
right.after: He nods. He looks great. He’s a bit red.

car.text: “The bridal car’s on the service road. Guests are arriving. Can it just stay here?”

left.label: Move it to the field
left.after: Twenty minutes in mud and dress shoes. The road is clear.

right.label: “Ten minutes, fine”
right.after: Nobody moves it again. Nobody even thinks about it.

ice.text: Tons of ice melting on the lawn. The corridor by the fuse room is close and cold. The cellar is a long way off.

left.label: Use the corridor
left.after: Done in five minutes. The caterer shakes your hand.

right.label: Carry it to the cellar
right.after: Forty trips down the stairs. You can’t feel your arms.

gas.text: A faint smell of gas. The chef swears it’s the ovens. Eighty plates go out in ten minutes.

left.label: Fan on full
left.after: The smell is gone. The fan howls like a plane.

right.label: Cut fuse, open a window
right.after: The kitchen goes dark. The chef calls you things you’ve never heard.

tables.text: “Twenty more guests showed up. Spread the tables to the back door. Who ever uses that door?”

left.label: Keep the aisle
left.after: Twenty people eat standing up. Emily won’t look at you.

right.label: Spread them
right.after: Everybody’s seated. Emily gives you a thumbs up.

knife.text: “Cake knife’s gone. Use the chef’s knife, it’s right here.” It’s huge. You look at your hands.

left.label: Chef’s knife
left.after: The cake cuts clean. You keep the knife close.

right.label: Bread knife
right.after: It tears the cake. Everyone laughs. Nobody gets hurt.

sparks.text: “Sparks for the first dance! Please. It’s the only thing I asked for.”

left.label: Set up the sparks
left.after: The room gasps. Gold falls through the air. It’s beautiful.

right.label: Just the LEDs
right.after: Pink and blue. The bride smiles for the photos only.

sam-down.text: Sam’s on the floor by the flowers. His lips are blue. The tie is cutting into his neck. His Epi-Pen is in your pocket.

left.label: Cut the tie
left.after: One cut. He drags in air. He’s alive, and he’s looking at you.

right.label: Use the Epi-Pen
right.after: Your wooden fingers find it. He gasps. Someone calls an ambulance.

bass.text: “They say the bass is weak. One word and I make this room shake.”

left.label: All the way up
left.after: The floor jumps. Everyone screams with joy. Dust drifts down through the lights.

panel.text: Water under the door. The ice has melted. The lights dip, come back, and dip again.

left.label: Go in, reset it
left.after: Wet shoes, one switch. The lights hold. Your heart barely does.

right.label: Shut the power off
right.after: The whole hall goes black and boos you.

door.text: “That rusty back door keeps swinging open. My mother’s freezing. Bolt it?”

left.label: Bolt it
left.after: It takes two of you. It won’t be swinging anymore.

right.label: Wedge it with a stone
right.after: Cold air on the dance floor. Emily sighs like you’re the problem.

beam.text: Plaster in your drink. You look up. The rope is creaking, and Emily is dancing right under it.

left.label: Pull her off the floor
left.after: You drag her away. The rope holds. For now.

right.label: Kill the music
right.after: Silence. Two hundred people stare at you. The rope stops creaking.

exit.text: A crack runs across the ceiling. Everyone is running. The bolt has rusted into the frame.

left.label: Force the bolt
left.after: It gives. Cold air. The road is clear, and you run.

right.label: Climb over the tables
right.after: Over the cake, past the flowers, out through a kitchen window.

last.text: “My bag’s still in there!” She’s already turning back. The ceiling is making a noise you know.

left.label: Drag her out
left.after: She screams at you the whole way. Then the roof goes.

right.label: Let her go
right.after: You don’t look back. You hear it anyway.

sam-throat.title: Sam’s Throat
sam-throat.text: You’re still on the floor with him when midnight comes. You knew what was coming. You stayed.
chain: You skipped the pill and your hands shook
sam-throat.hint: At least you saved on the wreath.

panel.title: The Panel
panel.text: The water found the panel. The fan burst. The gas had been waiting in the walls all evening.
chain: You stacked the ice by the fuse room
You ran the fan at full power
You walked in, wet shoes and all
panel.hint: You melted the ice. Now it’s your turn.

chandelier.title: The Chandelier
chandelier.text: The beam gave way. Two hundred kilos of crystal came down on you and Emily.
chain: You tied a rope to the old beam
You turned the bass all the way up
Your sparks lit the dust up there
You ran under it for Emily
chandelier.hint: You loved the bass. The ceiling danced with you.

trapped.title: Trapped
trapped.text: The way out was right there. You’d blocked it yourself, this afternoon.
chain: You left the bridal car on the road
You spread the tables to the door
trapped.hint: That door was very solid. Nobody could get in, and you couldn’t get out.

chest.title: Your Chest
chest.text: The room shrinks. Your chest closes. You go down between the tables, and nobody hears you over the music.
chest.hint: You controlled everything. Except your breathing.

best-man.title: Best Man
best-man.text: Your legs quit on the stairs. You carried everything today. Nobody carried you.
best-man.hint: You carried the whole wedding. The floor carried you.

uninvited.title: Uninvited
uninvited.text: You shout that the roof is coming down. They’ve heard enough from you today. Security walks you back into the hall.
chain: You said no to the bride
You said no to everyone else
uninvited.hint: You ruined the wedding to save it. Only one of those worked.

nobody-bled.title: Nobody Even Bled
nobody-bled.text: 00:00. The band stops. The ceiling stays. Sam is dancing badly. You look up at the old beam, and you understand: Every disaster today would have been your own idea.
nobody-bled.hint: Everyone lived. Nobody will ever thank you.

half-a-wedding.title: Half a Wedding
half-a-wedding.text: 00:00. The roof comes down behind you. Emily’s crying beside you, Sam’s on a stretcher. The rope, the bass, the bolt. You did that.
half-a-wedding.hint: Two out of three. Not bad for a best man.

walked-out.title: Walked Out
walked-out.text: 00:00. You’re alive on the lawn, holding the wedding program. There’s nobody left to give it to.
